query: How does goal achievement vary across department, metric, and the management practices described?

per_column.name: primary_intervention_type
per_column.rationale: Categorical management-practice variable with well-separated, interpretable levels (automation, process_redesign, training, etc.) that can be segmented and compared against goal achievement. Directly serves the 'management practices' dimension of the query.

per_column.name: improvement_lever
per_column.rationale: External associational categories (market_expansion, workflow_efficiency, cost_cutting) with reasonable spread; groupable and comparable against achievement. product_quality is thin (5) but overall usable.

per_column.name: timeframe_horizon
per_column.rationale: Interpretable ordinal horizon (quarter/year/multi-year) that plausibly relates to achievement rates. multi_year (1) and NULL (60) weaken it slightly but the two main buckets support clear comparison.

per_column.name: measurement_mechanism
per_column.rationale: How goals are measured (financial_kpi, survey_score, operational_kpi) is a well-separated segmentation aligned with the 'metric' dimension and comparable against achievement.

per_column.name: has_quantified_baseline
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary management-practice flag (420/130) with meaningful contrast; a natural grouping variable for exploring achievement differences.

per_column.name: initiative_scope
per_column.rationale: Clear organizational-scope categories (company_wide, department_wide, external_market) that can be segmented and compared against achievement; individual_team is thin but categories are interpretable.

per_column.name: involves_technology_investment
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary practice flag (391/159) enabling a well-separated comparison of achievement with/without tech investment.

per_column.name: involves_people_program
per_column.rationale: Interpretable binary practice flag (430/120) supporting clean segmentation of achievement by presence of people programs.

per_column.name: target_metric_alignment
per_column.rationale: Binary aligned/misaligned with balanced split (301/249); a highly interpretable management-quality variable expected to associate strongly with achievement.

judge.rationale: The added set is a strong realization of exploratory EDA intent for the management-practices dimension. Every column is an external, associational, interpretable categorical/binary variable with well-separated levels that can be grouped and compared against goal_achievement. None merely restate the focus, and none are opaque scores or near-constant (splits are generally balanced enough to compare). Minor weaknesses: a few thin/near-empty levels (multi_year=1, product_quality=5, individual_team=9) and some conceptual overlap between intervention_type, improvement_lever, involves_technology_investment and involves_people_program. But collectively they open up rich, human-interpretable relationships, so the set scores high.
